property_summary: Calling initialize with a fee rate of at most 5000 always succeeds and stores the given parameters, leaving initialized() true and feeRate() equal to the argument.
On a freshly deployed, uninitialized pool, any attempt to set the fee rate (even a valid rate ≤ 5000) must revert because the caller is not the pool's ERC721 owner.
On a fresh uninitialized pool, setting the fee rate always reverts because the caller is not the pool's NFT owner, and initialized stays false.
On an uninitialized pool, initialize() reverts whenever the fee rate exceeds 5000 and initialized() remains false.
A fresh C accepts exactly one valid initialize (storing all parameters and marking itself initialized), rejects initialization when feeRate exceeds 5000, and any second initialize always reverts.
